subs: Ten rules. If your country has the thing on the card... it gets invaded by its strongest neighbor. Only one country will survive.
Rule one. If your country has no army... you get invaded.
19 countries are marked. The Marshall Islands, Iceland, Mauritius.
Rule two. If your country has nuclear weapons... you get invaded. Nine countries. The most dangerous club on Earth.
9 countries are marked. China, India, the United States.
Rule three. If your country has a king or a queen... you get invaded.
33 countries are marked. Thailand, Saudi Arabia, Japan.
Rule four. If your country is an island... you get invaded.
20 countries are marked. Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Taiwan.
Rule five. If your country uses the euro... you get invaded.
15 countries are marked. Germany, Italy, Greece.
Rule six. If your country drives on the left... you get invaded.
14 countries are marked. Bangladesh, Nepal, South Africa.
Rule seven. If your country has no coastline... you get invaded.
28 countries are marked. Ethiopia, Afghanistan, South Sudan.
Rule eight. If your country has more than one hundred million people... you get invaded.
6 countries are marked. Vietnam, Egypt, Brazil.
Rule nine. If your flag has a star on it... you get invaded.
21 countries are marked. Turkey, Algeria, Myanmar.
Rule ten. If your country has a big desert... you get invaded.
4 countries are marked. Iran, Iraq, Sudan.
No more rules. Ukraine, South Korea, Eritrea, Colombia... are left. Now they fight.
Final purge. Only the four strongest armies survive. Ukraine, South Korea, Eritrea and Colombia.
The final duel. Ukraine against South Korea.
Ukraine is the last country standing.
